g.text: The request to /orders/7731 failed because the payment service timed out after 30 s. The same timeout appears

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

g.text: 41 times in the last hour, always after the connection pool reported 64 of 64 connections in use.

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

g.text: Most likely cause: the pool is too small for the 14:00 batch import, which holds connections for the length of

text.font-family: -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

g.text: each file. The first timeout follows the batch start by 2.1 s on every occasion in this log.
